name: archhelp-claude-plugin
description: Scan any GitHub repository and generate technical architecture diagrams, data flow diagrams, ER diagrams, component maps, and sequence diagrams.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: GitHub Personal Access Token for higher API rate limits. Get one at https://github.com/settings/tokens (read:repo scope). Without this, you are limited to 60 unauthenticated requests/hour.

tools.name: analyze_repository
tools.description: Analyze a GitHub repository and generate ALL diagrams at once: architecture, data flow, component map, ER diagram, sequence diagram, and deployment diagram.

tools.name: generate_architecture_diagram
tools.description: Generate a system architecture diagram (Mermaid) for a GitHub repository.

tools.name: generate_data_flow_diagram
tools.description: Generate a data flow diagram showing the request lifecycle for a GitHub repository.

tools.name: generate_er_diagram
tools.description: Generate an Entity-Relationship diagram by scanning ORM model definitions.

tools.name: generate_sequence_diagram
tools.description: Generate a sequence diagram showing request/response flow through the system.

tools.name: generate_component_diagram
tools.description: Generate a component/module dependency diagram from import analysis.

tools.name: generate_deployment_diagram
tools.description: Generate a deployment/infrastructure diagram from Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform configs.

tools.name: get_repo_overview
tools.description: Get a plain-text structural overview of a GitHub repository.
